name: Louis S. Wolk JCC of Greater Rochester
description: JCC Rochester offers American Mah Jongg for Beginners (4-week classes; instructors cover "Official National Mah Jongg League (NMJL) rules") and a play-only Mah Jongg Club for people who already know the game. Programs are for JCC members and non-members by registration; contact the JCC for pricing.
schedule: Mah Jongg Club: Tuesdays 10:00 AM-12:00 PM (Erdle Lounge; bring your own card and set; no instruction). Beginner classes: see events page.
